title: Unit – 4 : Session – 4 : SLO – 1  |  Logic Programming and Key Constructs
sections: 1. facts and rules are written using predicates (clauses) and terms — i.e. Horn clauses made of a head predicate and argument terms.
2. period (.) — every Prolog query (and clause) is terminated by a full stop.
Fact: father(ram, ravi).            % Ram is the father of Ravi
Rule: parent(X, Y) :- father(X, Y). % X is a parent of Y if X is the father of Y
